en.headline: Chief Secretary Chan departs for Dongguan GBA talent conference
en.dek: Chan Kwok-ki leaves for Dongguan this afternoon to attend the opening of the fourth Greater Bay Area High-quality Talent Development Conference and related events on Sunday.
body: Chief Secretary for Administration Chan Kwok-ki will depart for Dongguan this afternoon to attend the opening ceremony of the fourth Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area High-quality Talent Development Conference and the third GBA Doctoral and Postdoctoral Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition on Sunday.

The government said the event is jointly organised by the governments of Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao to further deepen talent exchanges and co-operation across the Greater Bay Area. During his stay, Mr Chan will also visit a key local enterprise and an educational institution.

Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun and Director of Hong Kong Talent Engage Felix Chan will join the visit. Mr Chan and Mr Sun are scheduled to return to Hong Kong on Sunday. During their absence, Deputy Chief Secretary Cheuk Wing-hing will act as Chief Secretary, while Under Secretary for Labour and Welfare Ho Kai-ming will act as Secretary for Labour and Welfare.

zh.headline: 政務司司長陳國基赴東莞出席大灣區人才大會
zh.dek: 陳國基今天下午前往東莞，出席星期日舉行的第四屆粵港澳大灣區人才高質量發展大會暨相關創新創業大賽開幕儀式。
body: 政務司司長陳國基今天下午將前往東莞，出席由粵港澳三地政府合辦的第四屆粵港澳大灣區人才高質量發展大會暨第三屆粵港澳大灣區博士博士後創新創業大賽開幕儀式。
政府表示，活動旨在進一步深化大灣區人才交流與合作。停留期間，陳國基亦會參訪當地重點企業及院校。
勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡及香港人才服務辦公室總監陳海勁隨行。陳國基與孫玉菡預計星期日返港。期間，政務司副司長卓永興署理司長職務，勞工及福利局副局長何啟明署理局長職務。
